title: SHIBOYUGI: Playing Death Games to Put Food on the Table 44: CLOUDY BEACH
native: 死亡遊戯で飯を食う。44:CLOUDY BEACH
synopsis:
Theatrical follow-up to Shibou Yuugi de Meshi wo Kuu.

This is a story about a deranged world.

Player name: Yuuki. Occupation: Professional death game player.

Having overcome the jinx known as the "Wall of Thirty," which drastically reduces the survival rates of players, Yuuki continues her journey.

Games where death is always close at hand. Her next challenge is on a remote island in the middle of the ocean. There, eight players have gathered. Among them are seasoned veterans whom Yuuki knows.

The game – "Cloudy Beach."

Beyond the wall, only those who have crossed the wall remain. Today, once again, she will play death games to put food on the table.

(Source: Official Site, translated)

episodes.title: Shiboyugi: Playing Death Games to Put Food on the Table: 44 - Cloudy Beach (Movie)
episodes.synopsis:
This is a story from a certain twisted world.
Player Name: Yuki. Occupation: professional death-game player.
Having overcome The Wall of Thirty — the jinx that causes a player's survival rate to plummet — Yuki keeps walking forward.
In a game where death is always within reach, her next challenge is a remote island cut off from the world. Eight players have been gathered there, and among them are veterans Yuki already knows.
The game: Cloudy Beach.
Beyond the wall lie only those who have crossed it. Today, as always, she plays death games to put food on the table.
